title: EventEnvelope
description: Common envelope for every event written to ./output/<runId>/events.jsonl. The payload schema is referenced per-event-type in contracts/events/<event_type>.schema.json.

sequenceNumber.description: Strictly increasing per runId. Defines causal order (Defining 200-Q1.5).

correlationId.description: Generated at CLI entry, propagated through the use case (Defining 300-Q6.2).

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Produced by the injected Clock.

payload.description: Discriminated by eventType; one of contracts/events/*.schema.json.
